details: For every binary concept class, combinatorial eluder dimension dominates Littlestone dimension. The half-interval family gives an unbounded separation: $\mathrm{Edim}=n-1$ while $\mathrm L=\Theta(\log n)$.
proof: Fix a hypothesis $h^*$ and follow the branch it realizes in any shattered Littlestone tree. At each node, shattering supplies a hypothesis realizing the branch that instead takes the opposite edge there. It agrees with $h^*$ at all earlier node labels and disagrees at the current node, so the nodes on the branch form an eluder witness of the same length.
name: Combinatorial Eluder Dimension / Littlestone Dimension
